A '''moon''' was the location of the [[Heinsnake Cult]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#S|sorcerers]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] energy was utilized into a superlaser via [[the Basis]].

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] doomed the moon to be destroyed by taking the basis' energy source with him, after wiping out the Heinsnake Cult due to their [[Heinsnake plot|assassination attempt]] on [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
